The Players Committee announced the cancellation erratum on 15 August 2008, effective 18 August. Cancellation protection such as Imperial Justice (V) and Abyss (V) can counter the new wording, and fallback battle destiny no longer counters it. The Used mode and cost are retained. The recovered art shows the August wording. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=20 Period cancellation rule].
